They greet a bemused adult and ask to be taken to the leader. Second read: the 'aliens' are your kid and the robot they built — and they want to meet your boss. The ask is one warm introduction.

projects/Take-Us-To-Your-Leader-Postcard.description: This is a black and white QR code with an orange lightning bolt icon in the center. The lightning bolt is positioned diagonally within a white square in the middle of the QR code.
